shareRefundDetails.subject: Your {amount} {instance} member share: where should we send it?
shareRefundDetails.preview: Reply to the co-op's treasury so we can refund your member share.
shareRefundDetails.heading: Let's refund your member share
shareRefundDetails.body: Your {amount} member share is due back to you. The co-op's treasury needs to know where to send it.
shareRefundDetails.deleteAtLabel: Your account will be deleted on
shareRefundDetails.reply: Write to {contact} from this address, quote the share reference, and say how you'd like the refund sent. The treasury replies with the next step.
shareRefundDetails.afterDeletion: If your account is deleted first, the refund is still owed: quote the share reference when you write.
shareRefundDetails.safety: We never ask for card numbers or passwords by email.
